value.rationale: An infinite, structurally natural dense-core/branching-hub community family exhibits a complete integer/weight optimal-bridge-placement phase diagram. A high-degree hub (eight contacts) loses to a degree-five clique site when bridge strength is low, then overtakes exactly at 2sqrt(10), with exact extinction-versus-persistence reversals in the associated SIS NLDS. This gives a motivated structural correction to static-degree targeting despite unchanged local community threshold set.
